spans.text:
By the 19th century, Portugal had fully incorporated Guinea-Bissau into its empire.

Since gaining independence in 1974, Guinea-Bissau has experienced considerable political and military upheaval.
In 1980, a military coup established General Joao Bernardo 'Nino' VIEIRA as president.
In 2005, VIEIRA was reelected, pledging to pursue economic development and national reconciliation; he was assassinated in 2009.
